result: TFQ-0413 assumption countermodels verified in Lean with explicit carrier, dimension, calibration and path boundaries.

proof_boundary.full_cones: Full SEP conic hull, BP trace dual, partial-transpose cone self-duality, local preservation, and separation by all local binary matrix tests.
proof_boundary.separations: Exact Bell and partial-transpose witnesses embed into every finite n,m>=2.
proof_boundary.interaction_failures: Two-qubit controlled shift: SEP forward closure and BP inverse closure fail. Twisted and dephased maps share the classical table but fail coherent calibration; the dephased controlled shift is not injective.
proof_boundary.twisted_dynamics: Reversibility and trace preservation assume a supplied unitary. Continuity assumes a supplied continuous matrix path; unitarity at each time is needed for reversible dynamics.
proof_boundary.hidden_coordinates: Doubled Hermitian carrier with positive trace-one indistinguishable states; a basis index constructs a normalized state. Product-test separation fails.
proof_boundary.external_classification: External theorem, not included in this Lean replay.
proof_boundary.primitive_gap: FQ-GAP-TENSOR-UNIQUENESS remains CONDITIONAL; no derivation of local complex QM or logical minimality theorem is asserted.

preservation.previous_measurement_receipt: Unmodified; its broad manifest is checked against its recorded historical Git revision.
